cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I copied your crossed arms at the pool door. Welcome back! Nobody through until the whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I crossed them because I'm cold. The pool's open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Come and warm up in reception; we'll wait for the whistle there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The lifeguard's just whistled for everyone to leave the water.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's keep their way clear. There's a lovely seat for you at the far end of reception.

reason: Trim the repetitive doorway explanation into one clear restriction and a warm distant seat offer. Reread whether the increasingly restrictive behavior remains sufficiently explicit.
